units.personality: young, determined, practical village traveler; alert rather than flashy
units.silhouette: compact athletic youth with topknot and asymmetrical travel load
units.signature_props: woven back basket, bamboo shoots, gourd, short bamboo staff
units.idle_behavior: low ready stance, steady breath, one shoulder subtly settling the basket
units.signature_attack: draw a short bamboo staff and deliver one compact leftward sweep through center
units.hit_behavior: brace late, absorb impact through shoulder and torso, recover stubbornly
units.buff_behavior: quietly square shoulders and tighten grip with renewed resolve
units.death_behavior: knees buckle, protect the basket, then settle onto one side without rolling

units.personality: fierce, disciplined young swordswoman; impatient and direct
units.silhouette: lean fighter with high ponytail, long sash and oversized curved saber
units.signature_props: broad curved saber, red waist sash, long ponytail
units.idle_behavior: forward-weighted duelist stance, blade low, ponytail and sash lightly delayed
units.signature_attack: one fast rising diagonal saber cut toward the left, stopping inside the safety zone
units.hit_behavior: sharp shoulder recoil, feet planted, immediate angry recovery
units.buff_behavior: lift chin, roll blade wrist once and lock into a sharper guard
units.death_behavior: saber lowers first, one knee drops, then torso folds beside the blade

units.personality: stoic, dependable veteran; protective and hard to move
units.silhouette: broad square body behind a round shield with a tall spear
units.signature_props: round wooden shield, spear, padded vest
units.idle_behavior: wide planted stance, shield forward, controlled weight shifts under heavy gear
units.signature_attack: short shield check followed by a compact spear thrust to the left
units.hit_behavior: impact lands on shield, torso compresses, spear wobbles once, feet hold
units.buff_behavior: raise shield to chest and stamp once with calm confidence
units.death_behavior: spear lowers, shield catches the body, then he kneels behind it

units.personality: warm, optimistic herbalist; agile, gentle and resourceful
units.silhouette: soft rounded clothing with flowing green cape and herb-filled pack
units.signature_props: double gourd, herb basket, leaf hair ornament, green cape
units.idle_behavior: light buoyant stance, cape breathes, gourd and herbs sway softly
units.signature_attack: swing the smaller gourd leftward and flick a compact herbal splash at center
units.hit_behavior: startled recoil protecting the large gourd, then a determined small recovery
units.buff_behavior: hug the gourd, inhale, then open the free hand with a reassuring smile
units.death_behavior: cape sinks, gourd is lowered carefully, then she folds into a seated slump

units.personality: cunning, focused young archer; economical and confident
units.silhouette: low triangular cloak silhouette with compact bow and three visible fletchings
units.signature_props: short recurve bow, quiver with three arrow fletchings, angular cloak
units.idle_behavior: crouched tracking stance, eyes scan left, bow hand stays ready
units.signature_attack: nock one arrow, compact draw, release left at the synchronized hit point
units.hit_behavior: duck and twist away while preserving bow and quiver alignment
units.buff_behavior: check the bowstring once, narrow the eyes and settle lower
units.death_behavior: bow slips down, crouch collapses to one knee, cloak settles over the body

units.personality: playful, clever talisman caster; theatrical but controlled
units.silhouette: round blue robe, circular collar, wand and floating rectangular talismans
units.signature_props: short wand, two talisman cards, blue ritual cap and collar
units.idle_behavior: relaxed sway, one eye teasingly narrowed, talismans hover in a small orbit
units.signature_attack: snap the wand left and launch one talisman in a flat straight path through center
units.hit_behavior: robe compresses, talismans scatter slightly, then return to formation
units.buff_behavior: wink, circle the wand once and align both talismans neatly overhead
units.death_behavior: talisman cards lose lift, wand lowers, robe settles into a compact kneel

units.personality: calm, calculating strategist; quietly smug and precise
units.silhouette: layered scholar robes with fan extended left and square formation banner behind
units.signature_props: folding fan, formation banner, hairpin
units.idle_behavior: upright relaxed poise, fan taps once, banner cloth breathes slowly
units.signature_attack: cut the fan left in one precise horizontal command gesture as the banner snaps
units.hit_behavior: brief loss of composure, fan shields the chest, banner pole flexes and settles
units.buff_behavior: open the fan fully and give one assured nod as the banner straightens
units.death_behavior: fan closes, banner droops, strategist lowers into a controlled seated collapse

units.personality: imposing, stubborn tribal chief; proud, territorial and authoritative
units.silhouette: massive angular red cloak, conical hat, crescent moustache and forked staff
units.signature_props: forked wooden staff, huge red cloak, conical hat, tusk-like moustache
units.idle_behavior: low broad stance, staff planted, cloak corners rise and settle like rigid banners
units.signature_attack: haul the forked staff from the ground into one short leftward hook and body check
units.hit_behavior: cloak absorbs the blow, head snaps back slightly, staff slams down to hold balance
units.buff_behavior: pull the free fist to the chest and glare forward while the cloak flares once
units.death_behavior: staff remains planted as knees give way, cloak folds around a kneeling silhouette

units.personality: sly showman and gambler; charming, fast-handed and overconfident
units.silhouette: tall narrow red figure with pointed hat and fan of cards
units.signature_props: three paper cards, pointed woven hat, red robe, small waist box
units.idle_behavior: hip cocked, cards shuffle between fingers, grin shifts with a small shoulder bounce
units.signature_attack: flick one card left like a blade while the other two remain clearly in hand
units.hit_behavior: grin breaks, hat tilts, cards nearly scatter before being snatched back
units.buff_behavior: fan all three cards at chest level and flash a sharper knowing grin
units.death_behavior: cards fall first, legs cross awkwardly, then the lanky body folds beneath the hat

units.personality: mischievous moon-blue spirit flame; curious, proud and mercurial
units.silhouette: single floating flame mass with crescent tips, tendrils and three bubbles
units.signature_props: blue flame body, curling tendrils, three floating bubbles
units.idle_behavior: hovering pulse, tips curl independently, bubbles orbit slowly without drifting
units.signature_attack: compress into a small blue core then dart left as one compact flame wave
units.hit_behavior: flatten and ripple backward, bubbles scatter slightly, then body re-forms
units.buff_behavior: flame brightens, grows one confident crown-like tip and spins bubbles upward
units.death_behavior: flame loses height, separates into three dim wisps, then settles into a tiny ember

units.personality: world-weary wandering scholar; dry, unhurried and secretly dangerous
units.silhouette: huge flat woven hat, dark robe, bamboo scroll and orange fox wrapped over shoulders
units.signature_props: wide hat, bamboo scroll case, shoulder fox, long moustache
units.idle_behavior: heavy relaxed lean, hat barely nods, fox blinks and tail curls lazily
units.signature_attack: raise the bamboo scroll to chest height and snap it left in a compact baton strike
units.hit_behavior: robe and hat absorb recoil while the fox braces and flicks its tail
units.buff_behavior: lift the scroll across the chest, half-open one eye and let the fox raise its head
units.death_behavior: protect the fox and scroll, sink to one knee, then bow beneath the hat

units.personality: sleepy, laid-back pipe smoker; deceptively calm and slippery
units.silhouette: soft green rounded robe, low straw hat, long pipe resting across one shoulder
units.signature_props: long bamboo pipe, straw hat with red leaves, waist pouch
units.idle_behavior: slow strolling-in-place weight shift, pipe balances on shoulder, eyelids droop
units.signature_attack: slide the pipe from the shoulder into one quick leftward jab and retract
units.hit_behavior: pipe bounces, hat tips, body recoils with annoyed surprise rather than panic
units.buff_behavior: take one calm breath through the pipe and straighten with a faint smirk
units.death_behavior: pipe lowers, knees soften, then the sleepy figure sits and slumps under the hat

units.personality: bright, graceful bell dancer; playful, brave and rhythmically expressive
units.silhouette: flowing red-yellow dancer with long split ribbons, pearl cap and two hand bells
units.signature_props: large green bell, small gold bell, long red-white ribbons, pearl headdress
units.idle_behavior: light dance step in place, wrists mark rhythm, ribbons follow in soft delayed arcs
units.signature_attack: pivot left and swing the large bell in one compact crescent strike through center
units.hit_behavior: spin half a step from impact, bells pull inward, then recover into rhythm
units.buff_behavior: raise both bells at chest height and complete one proud rhythmic flourish
units.death_behavior: ribbons lose lift, bells lower gently, dancer turns into a controlled kneeling fall

units.personality: proud, territorial farm rooster; loud and fearless
units.silhouette: upright flame-shaped comb and three sweeping tail sickles
units.signature_props: red comb, wattles, yellow beak, three red tail feathers
units.idle_behavior: chest puffed, head bobs once, tail feathers rebound with restrained swagger
units.signature_attack: compress low then deliver one short forceful peck to the right
units.hit_behavior: body compresses left, one wing flares, comb and wattles shake after impact
units.buff_behavior: rise taller, puff chest and stamp once in challenge
units.death_behavior: legs wobble, wings spread for balance, then body settles onto one side

units.personality: grumpy, stubborn goat; unimpressed until suddenly aggressive
units.silhouette: rounded square body with two massive backward horns and small beard
units.signature_props: large spiral horns, beard, compact hooves
units.idle_behavior: heavy side-to-side breathing, one hoof scrapes, brows remain flat
units.signature_attack: drop the head and make one compact horn-driven headbutt to the right
units.hit_behavior: horns lag behind a short body recoil, hooves stay braced
units.buff_behavior: snort, lower both horns and lock into a stubborn stance
units.death_behavior: front legs fold first, rounded body lowers and rests with horns safely inside frame

units.personality: sly, restless weasel; opportunistic and difficult to pin down
units.silhouette: very long S-curve body with oversized curled tail
units.signature_props: gold-brown body, dark paws, long looped tail
units.idle_behavior: body ripples low, nose tests the air, tail tip traces a small loop
units.signature_attack: coil briefly then spring into one low rightward bite and tail snap
units.hit_behavior: long torso bends into a tighter S and rebounds without changing facing
units.buff_behavior: tail coils higher, shoulders drop and eyes narrow with predatory focus
units.death_behavior: S-curve unwinds, body lowers in sections, tail curls beside the torso

units.personality: curious, skittish civet; cute at rest and frantic when threatened
units.silhouette: small round body under a huge spiral-striped tail
units.signature_props: mask face, rounded ears, oversized curled striped tail
units.idle_behavior: tiny paw shifts, ears twitch, huge tail bobs like a counterweight
units.signature_attack: hop forward and whip the curled tail once to the right
units.hit_behavior: body squashes, eyes widen, tail springs upward then settles
units.buff_behavior: tail expands into a proud spiral and ears stand sharply upright
units.death_behavior: small body curls under the large tail and becomes still

units.personality: cold elite rooster; disciplined, severe and blade-like
units.silhouette: dark wedge body with layered metal-plated wings and spear-like tail feathers
units.signature_props: iron wing plates, black blade tail, red crest, scarred eye
units.idle_behavior: rigid sentry posture, metal feathers click once, head tracks right
units.signature_attack: step once and carve a short rightward wing-blade slash
units.hit_behavior: armor plates chatter, torso jolts left, stance immediately re-locks
units.buff_behavior: fan the iron plates outward and lower the scarred brow
units.death_behavior: metal wings lose tension, legs buckle, armored body settles heavily

units.personality: regal mountain goat; aloof, proud and explosively forceful
units.silhouette: four-legged cream body crowned by two enormous blue crescent horns
units.signature_props: blue crescent horns, long beard, layered mountain coat
units.idle_behavior: slow proud breath, beard sways, one forehoof presses into the ground
units.signature_attack: lower both horns and make one short crushing charge to the right
units.hit_behavior: front shoulders recoil, horns lag slightly, all four hooves regain purchase
units.buff_behavior: lift the horn crown high and stamp once with controlled authority
units.death_behavior: front knees lower, head and horns descend carefully, body folds behind them

units.personality: lean, cautious wolf; hungry, suspicious and fast
units.silhouette: low arrow-shaped four-legged body with long horizontal tail
units.signature_props: gray angular coat, pointed ears, narrow muzzle and tail
units.idle_behavior: low stalking breath, ears alternate, paws tense without sliding
units.signature_attack: one compact rightward pounce ending in a snapping bite
units.hit_behavior: ribcage bends left, paws dig in, tail whips once behind
units.buff_behavior: hackles rise and muzzle lowers into a more focused stalk
units.death_behavior: hindquarters sink, forelegs fold, head rests along the arrow-like body

units.personality: stubborn wild boar; simple, irritable and relentless
units.silhouette: dense barrel body with low head and short upward tusks
units.signature_props: barrel torso, brown bristles, twin ivory tusks
units.idle_behavior: barrel chest heaves, hoof scratches, snout jerks with an angry grunt
units.signature_attack: compress and surge one short distance right in a tusk-first ram
units.hit_behavior: barrel body rocks left as one mass, bristles and ears lag
units.buff_behavior: bristles rise, snout lowers and both tusks square toward the target
units.death_behavior: momentum drains, front legs spread, barrel body lowers onto its belly

units.personality: mischievous macaque; playful, noisy and opportunistic
units.silhouette: round seated body with question-mark tail and raised stone
units.signature_props: small stone, curled tail, large round ears
units.idle_behavior: rock bounces lightly in one hand, grin shifts, tail tip makes a question mark
units.signature_attack: wind the arm once and throw the single stone right through center
units.hit_behavior: startled squash, free hand catches balance, tail straightens then curls back
units.buff_behavior: toss the stone once, catch it and grin with both ears lifted
units.death_behavior: stone drops, seated posture slumps, tail uncurls around the feet

units.personality: defensive porcupine; nervous, stubborn and dangerous when cornered
units.silhouette: low dark body buried beneath a large radial sunburst of quills
units.signature_props: alternating black-gold quills, tiny face and paws
units.idle_behavior: body barely breathes while quill tips ripple in a small wave
units.signature_attack: compress quills then thrust the front quill fan sharply to the right
units.hit_behavior: quill sunburst flattens left and rebounds around the small body
units.buff_behavior: raise every quill into a cleaner radial crown and hold firm
units.death_behavior: quills slowly droop inward, covering the body in a compact mound

units.personality: dominant alpha wolf; controlled, intimidating and brutally decisive
units.silhouette: large diamond-shaped black mane around a long pale face and four planted legs
units.signature_props: towering gray-black mane, pale spear-like muzzle, long tail
units.idle_behavior: heavy silent breath expands the mane, head remains low and unblinking
units.signature_attack: drive forward in one compact rightward claw-and-bite lunge
units.hit_behavior: mane absorbs a deep recoil, forepaws skid only within the central zone
units.buff_behavior: mane lifts into a sharper diamond and shoulders rise over the head
units.death_behavior: front legs buckle, mane collapses around the face, body lowers behind it

units.personality: elite boar king; furious, armored and obsessed with overpowering resistance
units.silhouette: low trapezoid body with huge outward tusks and tall red dorsal crest
units.signature_props: red wrapped tusks, red blade-like mane, massive snout
units.idle_behavior: low ground-hugging stance, crest trembles, tusks scrape in alternating beats
units.signature_attack: one short rightward tusk uppercut driven by the entire trapezoid body
units.hit_behavior: head is forced left, crest bends, hind legs catch the heavy recoil
units.buff_behavior: crest rises, tusks square outward and hooves hammer once
units.death_behavior: tusks lower to the ground first, then the massive body settles between them

units.personality: patient venomous snake; calculating, still and suddenly precise
units.silhouette: flat circular coil with a vertical S-neck and angular hooded head
units.signature_props: geometric coil markings, two fangs, olive hood
units.idle_behavior: coil tightens imperceptibly, head sways within a narrow arc, tongue flicks once
units.signature_attack: compress the S-neck then make one needle-fast rightward fang strike
units.hit_behavior: neck kinks left while the circular coil stays centered and stable
units.buff_behavior: raise the hood higher and tighten the coil into a perfect target shape
units.death_behavior: hood lowers, S-neck uncoils and head rests across the circular base

units.personality: twitchy wildcat; suspicious, spring-loaded and spiteful
units.silhouette: angular crouched body with very tall ears, sharp muzzle and lightning tail
units.signature_props: oversized ears, golden eyes, zigzag tail
units.idle_behavior: ears swivel, shoulders pulse low, lightning tail gives one impatient snap
units.signature_attack: spring into one shallow rightward claw pounce and recoil
units.hit_behavior: body arches left, ears flatten, tail forms a sharper zigzag
units.buff_behavior: ears spear upward, pupils narrow and tail locks into an alert angle
units.death_behavior: crouch loses tension, paws fold, long ears lower over the head

units.personality: disdainful vulture; patient, calculating and cruelly opportunistic
units.silhouette: heavy kite-shaped folded wings around a bald hooked head
units.signature_props: layered brown wing triangles, pale ruff, hooked black beak
units.idle_behavior: slow hunched breathing, one eyelid lowers, wing tips shift like stacked plates
units.signature_attack: unfold one wing and drive a short rightward beak-and-wing chop
units.hit_behavior: wing stack fans left, neck retracts, talons hold the same anchor
units.buff_behavior: raise the ruff and open both wing shoulders into a larger kite silhouette
units.death_behavior: neck droops, wings unfold downward and cover the talons

units.personality: stoic giant toad; slow, blank-faced and unexpectedly explosive
units.silhouette: very wide flat stone body with tiny square eyes and short feet
units.signature_props: flat gray-green body, blue cheek circles, stone-like spots
units.idle_behavior: almost motionless except one deep body inflation and a slow blink
units.signature_attack: inflate once then make one compact forward body hop and tongue jab right
units.hit_behavior: flat body ripples like a struck cushion and settles with the same blank stare
units.buff_behavior: inflate slightly larger and plant all four tiny feet outward
units.death_behavior: body deflates gradually and lowers into an even flatter stone shape

units.personality: brooding white ape; powerful, weary and resentful
units.silhouette: inverted-U long white arms around a dark face and a single boulder
units.signature_props: long white fur, dark hands and face, round boulder
units.idle_behavior: knuckles bear weight, shoulders breathe heavily, one hand rolls the boulder slightly
units.signature_attack: lift the boulder only to chest height and hammer it down-right in one short smash
units.hit_behavior: long arms absorb the recoil, fur trails behind, boulder remains controlled
units.buff_behavior: pull the boulder to the chest and rise into a taller threatening arch
units.death_behavior: release the boulder beside the body, arms sag and the white arch collapses

units.personality: aloof spirit deer; elegant, watchful and untouchably proud
units.silhouette: very slender four-legged body under a huge symmetrical antler fan
units.signature_props: broad branching antlers, cream coat, needle-thin legs
units.idle_behavior: minimal graceful breathing, ears turn, antler fan tilts by a few degrees
units.signature_attack: take one precise step and sweep the antler fan right in a compact arc
units.hit_behavior: long neck bows left, thin legs flex without tangling, antlers lag softly
units.buff_behavior: lift the neck and fully present the antler crown with quiet authority
units.death_behavior: front legs kneel, neck curves down and antlers settle behind the body

units.personality: festive greedy rat boss; flamboyant, smug and obsessed with wealth
units.silhouette: broad triangular rat behind a huge square-holed coin with coin chains fanning upward
units.signature_props: large coin shield, red festive robe, multiple coin strings, curled whiskers
units.idle_behavior: coin shield rocks, whiskers curl, hanging coins bounce in a cheerful greedy rhythm
units.signature_attack: ram the coin shield right once, then flick one small coin through center
units.hit_behavior: shield rings back into the body, coin chains recoil and jingle in delayed waves
units.buff_behavior: raise the coin shield proudly and fan the coin strings like a golden crown
units.death_behavior: small coins drop inward, shield tilts down, boss slumps behind the large coin

units.personality: massive black bear boss; calm, immovable and crushingly strong
units.silhouette: mountain-like dark body with enormous column arms and pale chest crescent
units.signature_props: huge forearms, pale crescent chest, small stern face
units.idle_behavior: slow mountain-like breath, one knuckle bears more weight, tiny eyes track right
units.signature_attack: raise one huge forearm within frame and deliver a short rightward ground-level slam
units.hit_behavior: upper mass rocks left while both arms catch and damp the motion
units.buff_behavior: rise slightly taller, widen both arms and expose the chest crescent
units.death_behavior: arms lower first, mountain torso sinks between them and becomes still

units.personality: ferocious tiger boss; explosive, dominant and permanently enraged
units.silhouette: low giant-paw body with blocky head and a complete circular striped tail
units.signature_props: oversized front paws, orange-black stripes, ring tail, one glaring eye
units.idle_behavior: low predatory breathing, claws flex, ring tail rotates only slightly without opening
units.signature_attack: drive one giant paw right in a compact claw swipe while the body stays crouched
units.hit_behavior: head and shoulders jerk left, claws dig down, circular tail compresses and rebounds
units.buff_behavior: spread both giant paws, bare fangs and tighten the tail into a perfect ring
units.death_behavior: front paws slide inward, head lowers between them and ring tail relaxes behind
